description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the watchtower: a tall square stone tower over an arched gateway with an open oak gate, a wooden lookout platform with a peaked shingle roof at the top, a horn and a torch at the lookout, a red pennant on a pole
